analysis.headline: No Data Selling/Sharing Explicit
analysis.quote: This document outlines their privacy principles without detailing data sharing practices for marketing or with affiliates.

analysis.headline: Good Privacy Transparency
analysis.quote: We are honest and transparent about our privacy practices.

analysis.headline: You Control Your Content
analysis.quote: You can control who interacts with your content, and how it affects your experience on Twitch.

analysis.headline: Your Data, Your Choices
analysis.quote: Twitch provides a variety of choices regarding how we use the information we collect about you, and how you can manage your information on Twitch.

analysis.headline: Products Designed for Privacy
analysis.quote: Data protection principles are built into Twitch products from the start.
